risks.title: Deterioration of credit quality
risks.score_rationale: The risk factor is central to the 10-K, with detailed ACL modeling based on macroeconomic forecasts. The language emphasizes uncertainty and model imprecision. The weighting is high because credit is critical for a community bank. Positioned at the top of critical accounting risks.

risks.title: Dependence on economic forecasts
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions that one of the most significant judgments concerns macro forecasts. The use of an external scenario (Moody's) adjusted qualitatively shows high sensitivity. Risk amplified by the forecast cycle duration (six quarters).

risks.title: Litigation risk
risks.score_rationale: The amount of 2.1 million dollars in litigation provisions is noted, indicating a measurable but not major risk. The language is factual, without emphasis on existential threat. Litigation category of moderate severity.

risks.title: Post-merger integration (Lakeland)
risks.score_rationale: The Lakeland merger in 2024 is a major event (876.8M $). The document mentions branch closures, implying operational and cultural integration risks. While not explicitly stated as a direct risk, the scale of the transaction warrants high vigilance.

risks.title: Interest rate risk
risks.score_rationale: The text indicates that a rapid rising rate environment has a negative effect on net interest income. This risk is repeated in General, underscoring its importance. The portfolio oriented toward adjustable-rate loans increases exposure.

risks.title: Cyberrisks linked to digital services
risks.score_rationale: While not explicitly mentioned, the development of mobile banking, online banking and other digital services implies growing exposure to cyber threats. By sector analogy, this risk is implicit but not directly documented in the risk factors.

ai_positioning.summary: PFS does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
